patch_description: Add RX rotation layers and parametrized CRY controlled rotations to increase ansatz expressivity. The seed uses only RY/RZ single-qubit rotations and fixed CZ entanglement, which limits the parameter space exploration. By adding RX gates for complete SU(2) coverage and replacing alternating CZ gates with parametrized CRY gates, the circuit gains learnable two-qubit interactions that can better fit the binary classification task. This improves accuracy and reduces generalization gap while maintaining a reasonable parameter budget.
